recent.text: Before tonight, the Hawks had not won a game while scoring 87 points or fewer since Feb. 28, 2016.
recent.author: Brad Rowland
recent.quoted_text: The Hawks have won East Group C and advanced to the NBA Cup quarterfinals with a 87-86 victory in Boston. Atlanta trailed by as many as 17 points but played a dominant second half defensively. 24 points, 12 rebounds for Jalen Johnson to lead the Hawks. @LockedOnHawks to come.

recent.text: Jalen Johnson in the walkoff interview: "We're trying to go get that money now."
recent.author: Kevin Chouinard

recent.text: FINAL: Hawks 87, Celtics 86 The Hawks clinch East Group C and head to the Knockout rounds.
recent.author: Lauren L. Williams
recent.quoted_text: Wow... just wow... The Hawks turn the ball over but they get it back after NAW stripped Jayson Tatum and Dyson Daniels got the loose ball. NAW got fouled by Hugo Gonzalez, he makes both FTs.

recent.text: 3Q: Hawks 70, Celtics 69 Hawks got a Dyson Daniels switch onto Baylor Scheierman and he hit a floater. Then Jayson Tatum tried to go at Zuby Ejiofor and his layup fell short. Really good third from the Hawks to claw back into this one. They held the Celtics to 18 points.
recent.author: Lauren L. Williams

recent.text: Then they get a 3 from Johnson w/ 3:19 and the Hawks have cut this game to 67-63
recent.author: Lauren L. Williams
recent.quoted_text: 3:58, 3Q -- Celtics 65, Hawks 60 The Hawks have been on a 10-0 run with a couple of buckets from NAW, a dunk from Okongwu and 3 from Lu Dort. They've got this game to the smallest margin since the first quarter and force the Celtics to call timeout.
